name: SIX homeobox 2
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: SIX2 encodes homeobox protein SIX2. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and cell migration.

function.text: SIX2 encodes homeobox protein SIX2. Based in part on similarity, it is a transcription factor that plays an important role in the development of several organs, including kidney, skull and stomach. It acts through its interaction with TCF7L2 and OSR1 in a canonical Wnt signaling independent manner preventing transcription of differentiation genes in cap mesenchyme such as WNT4. It also acts independently of OSR1 to activate expression of many cap mesenchyme genes, including itself, GDNF and OSR1.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SIX2 have been reported in Wilms tumor.
